exposure: whole blood bilirubin measured by GEM Premier 4000 R
plasma bilirubin measured by VITROS 5600 R
outcome: sensitivity and specificity of GEM bilirubin in contrast to VITROS bilirubin
cohort: 440 healthy newborn infants who had plasma bilirubin ordered for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia screening
finding: An imperfect correlation was observed between whole blood bilirubin measured on the GEM4000 R and plasma bilirubin on the VITROS 5600 R, with specimen hemolysis and hemoglobin measurements affecting the accuracy of GEM results.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by caesarean section had lower hemoglobin levels.
